caption: The drawing consists of black pencil or ink lines and text on a pale, off-white or cream-colored background. On the right side of the image, there is a large rectangular outline with an internal dotted horizontal line near the bottom edge and another vertical dotted line labeled "Center Back." At the top right corner of this rectangle, there is a short dashed line and a small arrow pointing rightward, and just below this line is a dashed notch. On the left side of the image, there is a block of hand-written instructions in capital letters. The text begins with labeled skirt components (G-G1, G-2, G-3) and provides detailed sewing instructions, describing features such as pleats, shirring, a pocket space, facing width at the bottom indicated by the dotted line, and the attachment of the lining and waistband. The writing and drawing are both neatly contained within a slightly darker rectangular border that frames the entire composition.
title: Description of a Dress
